d:
A woman breaks up.
Gia has just broken up with her long-term partner of seven years. Codependent and a "relationship junkie," she's spinning out, finding herself alone and wandering late at night right after the event.
She ends up in a convenience store, where her friends track her down, ply her with snacks and offer her support. With their raucous and loving help, they help Gia navigate her heartbreak, dream bigger and awaken from autopilot.
